findings.finding: GitHub Actions budgets can prevent jobs from starting. A blocked job provides no test result, even when equivalent checks have passed locally.
findings.relevance: The website's merged-commit checks have zero executed steps and a budget-block annotation.
findings.direction_alignment: Preserve the existing hosted validation gate without expanding MVP scope.
findings.opportunity_or_risk: A successful local audit must not be reported as successful hosted Actions execution.
findings.engineering_cost: Record the limitation and retain the existing workflows.
findings.roadmap_delta: Record implementation and maintainer review as complete while retaining the hosted validation item.
findings.verification_needed: Rerun the existing website checks when its Actions budget permits execution.

findings.finding: Cloudflare Workers Builds can build and deploy changes from a connected Git repository. A successful build status still needs read-only verification of the served content and evidence.
findings.relevance: The maintainer's website merge triggered its existing successful Cloudflare build.
findings.direction_alignment: Validate the already-served integration within the approved MVP audit.
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Stale or altered recording assets can invalidate a working-looking replay.
findings.engineering_cost: Reuse the existing browser and content audits, and compare served file hashes.
findings.roadmap_delta: Complete the post-merge evidence audit; retain versioned release as a separate decision.
findings.verification_needed: Check accessible replay behavior and served evidence against the reviewed immutable artifacts.

overall_recommendation: No material direction change. Finish the existing MVP audit, retain measured CPU and Isaac results, and avoid new feature work while release validation remains pending.
evidence_gaps: Website GitHub Actions execution remains blocked by its budget.
A versioned release has not been approved or created.
